title: Ryder Azadi
description: Once the governor of Lothal, Ryder Azadi was accused of treason, clapped in chains, and tossed into an Imperial prison with Ezra Bridger's parents. With their help, he managed to escape the prison and return to Lothal to fight for the liberation of his planet, standing up against the tyrannical jackboots of the Imperial occupation. He threw his lot in with forces of the Rebellion, including the elements led by Hera Syndulla to further his cause. He fought alongside them in their final battle and regained the mantle of Governor.
